senses.gloss: (b. h. r.; v. גבב) [to give a rounded shape,] to to knead, stamp.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:3">Sabb. XXIV, 3</cite> you may put water into the bran (on the Sabbath) <he>אבל לא גוֹבְלִין</he> but must not mix it to a mass.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:13">Tosef. Maasr. III, 13</cite> <he>גובל עיסתו</he> he kneads his dough.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> <he>בד׳ גְּבָלוֹ</he> (Pesik. Baḥod. p. 150ᵇ <he>גִּיבְּלוֹ</he>) on the fourth day He formed the dust into a mass.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="C00102">same</cite>. Y. Ter. V, 43ᶜ bot. <he>הפריש ואח״כ גי׳</he> he set apart (the T’rumah) and then made the dough.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 10a:3">Taan. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>שמְגַ׳ את הגבינה</he> that forms a cheese.
<cite ref="Taanit 19b:14">Ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>שמג׳ את הטיט</he> that stamps clay; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְגוּבָּל</he>.
<cite ref="Taanit 19b">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ יפה</he> a thoroughly kneaded mass.

senses.gloss: to be kneaded. Ib. אינו מִתְגַּבֵּל יפה is not thoroughly kneaded.
